# Atlas slow-query log and Performance Advisor automation — concept pack

> Atlas exposes Performance Advisor suggestions and slow query logs through Admin API v2 endpoints and the Atlas CLI (atlas api performanceAdvisor and atlas performanceAdvisor), scoped by process id with a default 24-hour window; managedSlowMs toggles the Atlas-managed dynamic slow threshold against a fixed 100 ms, and Project Read Only versus Project Owner roles gate reads and toggles. Compiled from Atlas documentation plus the run's verified claims.
